content: if the belts are too short and you are having space problems inserting them into the holder just loose or unscrew the belt tensioners you installed previously. in my case i unscrewed them and left them dangling.

Might want to call out that when aligning the belts with the edge, it's imperative that both belts are aligned as close to the same as possible. Otherwise, it will be very difficult to adjust belt tension and keep the XY carriage square at the same time.
